presence_rationale: Substantive climate-risk integration into capital allocation: climate stress testing for lending portfolio, sectoral decarbonisation pathways analysis, Board Risk Appetite Statement includes physical and transition risk measures (reviewed twice yearly). FY24 plans to update climate stress testing methodology.
specificity_rationale: Names Group ESG Credit Risk Policy, Customer and Transaction Risk Escalation Committee (CTREC), Board Risk Appetite Statement, Australian business division portfolio risk assessments, climate stress testing program (FY24 expansion plan). Joined NZBA principals/steering bodies.
quantification_rationale: Climate scenario analysis named with reference scenarios (IEA NZE 2050, CSIRO Hydrogen Superpower) and sector-level targets quantified. However, no G-SIB or D-SIB score, no CET1 / capital ratio numbers, no LCR/NSFR — these live in Westpac Annual Report Pillar 3, not this Climate Report. SASB FN-CB-550a.1 not in retrieved evidence; SASB FN-CB-550a.2 substantively covered through climate stress test integration.
